pages.text: The Fluid Mixer consumes FE to mix two input fluids (Tank A and Tank B) along with an optional item catalyst, outputting a new target fluid. It natively supports custom datapack recipes ($(thing)jdte:fluid_mixer$()) and Mekanism Chemical Infuser and Pigment Mixer recipes when Mekanism is present. $(br2)$(bold)Variants$()$(br2)$(bold)Machine | Upgrades | Energy | Tanks$()$(br)Advanced Fluid Mixer | 4+1 | 100k FE | 3 × 8k mB$(br)Extended Fluid Mixer | 8+1 | 200k FE | 3 × 8k mB

$(bold)Layout$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Input Tank A (Left)$(): Base capacity 8,000 mB$(li)$(bold)Input Tank B (Right)$(): Base capacity 8,000 mB$(li)$(bold)Catalyst Slot (Center)$(): 1 slot for optional item catalyst$(li)$(bold)Output Tank (Bottom)$(): Base capacity 8,000 mB for outputs$(br2)$(bold)Mixing Upgrade$()$(br2)A dedicated upgrade slot accepts 1 $(bold)Mixing Upgrade$(). When installed, enables parallel processing to produce multiple batches in a single cycle.
The standard Advanced Fluid Mixer with 4 standard upgrade slots and 1 Mixing Upgrade slot.
The Extended Fluid Mixer with 8 standard upgrade slots. Upgraded from an Advanced Fluid Mixer with an Extended Upgrade.
Mixing Upgrade: Dedicated to Fluid Mixers. Enables parallel batch mixing.
